scripts.check: bun scripts/run.ts "uv sync --frozen 2>/dev/null || uv sync; uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pyright && uv run lint-imports"
scripts.typecheck: bun scripts/run.ts "uv sync --frozen 2>/dev/null || uv sync; uv run pyright"
scripts.test: bun scripts/run.ts "uv sync --frozen 2>/dev/null || uv sync; uv run pytest"
scripts.test:int: bun scripts/run.ts "uv sync --frozen 2>/dev/null || uv sync; uv run pytest -m int"
